en.hook: Resolve Postgres WAL replication slot disk bloat before primary storage fills up.
en.body:
Resolve Postgres WAL replication slot disk bloat before primary storage fills up. Enforce max_slot_wal_keep_size and fail-safes to preserve OLTP uptime.

Operational proof is in the GitHub repository referenced in this post.
en.cta: Read the full article on the site, then open GitHub for operational proof.

pt.hook: Resolva o bloat de WAL por replication slot no Postgres antes que o disco encha.
pt.body:
Resolva o bloat de WAL por replication slot no Postgres antes que o disco encha. Use max_slot_wal_keep_size e fail-safes para proteger a alta disponibilidade.

A prova operacional está no repositório GitHub referenciado neste post.
pt.cta: Leia o artigo completo no site e abra o GitHub como prova operacional.
